iPod Day is an unofficial observance celebrated annually on October 23. It commemorates the anniversary of the original iPod's launch by Apple Inc., which was announced on October 23, 2001. The day is dedicated to remembering and celebrating the impact of the iPod, a revolutionary portable music player that changed the way people listened to and carried music.
The iPod was a groundbreaking device that influenced not only personal music consumption but also broader tech trends, paving the way for future mobile devices such as the iPhone. Fans, tech enthusiasts, and nostalgia seekers use the day to revisit their old iPods, share memories, and appreciate the role the device played in music and technology history.

How it's observed:
* ﻿﻿Some people dig out their old iPods to listen to music the "old-school" way.
* ﻿﻿Social media posts, stories, and shared memories about the iPod and its influence.
* ﻿﻿Retrospectives, articles, or videos discussing the iPod's legacy in pop culture and technology.

images.alt: Ilustración técnica y conceptual en blanco y negro, en formato cuadrado (1:1), dibujada con la estética de una pluma de tinta fina hiperrealista. La obra representa de forma rigurosa la Biosfera de Montreal, la icónica cúpula geodésica de acero diseñada por Buckminster Fuller. Se muestra la esfera metálica desnudada, dejando ver en su interior las estructuras de plataformas asimétricas y el pabellón de acceso de perfil bajo con su rampa de entrada y paisajismo real. El dibujo combina el trazo preciso y arquitectónico de la estructura con un fondo característico de "caos controlado" compuesto por cientos de líneas rectas y radiantes en abanico que se cruzan sutilmente detrás y alrededor del edificio sobre un fondo blanco puro.
